experiments.description: Cross-topology MPNN transfer: train on chain, deploy on ladder/triangular
experiments.hypothesis: MPNN trained on chain_1d generalizes to other topologies with ΔE/gap < 10% (zero-shot) or < 5% (3-point fine-tune).

experiments.description: Data efficiency at N=10: find k_min training points
experiments.hypothesis: k_min(N=10) ≈ 11-13 points for ΔE/gap < 5% (vs k_min(N=6) = 9). Scaling of k_min with N.
